facts.text: I am in the process of buying a house.
I agreed on a house price with the seller that is $5,000 higher than my initial offer.
I received a $2,000 credit from the seller for closing costs.
I was pre-approved for a mortgage of $350,000.
I am considering a 30-year mortgage with 4% interest.
I thought my pre-approval amount was $350,000.
I am buying the house for $325,000.
The purchase price of $325,000 is $5,000 higher than my initial offer.

keyphrases: total cost of ownership for a house
purchase price $5,000 higher than initial offer
finding property tax rate for my area
